annotations.title: Crypto price: live USD price of a coin or token

description: Crypto price and token price in USD, live: give a symbol (ETH, BTC, LINK, AERO, ARB, OP), a coin name or an ERC-20 address and get its price from the deepest Uniswap v3 pool on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum or Optimism, with the pool and a thin-liquidity flag. Use to price a token for a quote, a portfolio or a trade. Example: symbol=ETH. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

address.description: 0x ERC-20 token contract address (instead of symbol)

chain.description: Network: base (default), eth, arb or op

symbol.description: Ticker such as ETH, BTC, USDC, AERO, ARB, OP or LINK (instead of address; ETH and BTC mean the wrapped tokens)
